status: Declared before any rigor-family run. All empirical targets have been inspected before; these are not prospective preregistrations. Thresholds below are applied mechanically by research/rigor/analyze.py. Change them only with a dated amendment entry and a new run directory.

recovery.note: Accuracy is the share of pseudo-observed datasets whose generating structure wins the ABC vote. Chance is 1/(number of structures). A design 'discriminates' only if it recovers every structure well, not just on average.

placebo.note: If at least 20% of placebo step months fit within LR < 3.84 of the best month, the data do not single out August 2021. The LR uses an iid Gaussian approximation and overstates precision when residuals are autocorrelated, so a 'singled out' verdict is weaker than it looks; a 'not singled out' verdict is conservative.

forecast.note: Model is called better or worse than a benchmark only when the HLN-corrected Diebold-Mariano test rejects at 5%. Otherwise: no detectable difference.

fertility.note: A levels fit is 'not distinguishable from trending' if at least 5% of independent random walks (matched drift and volatility) fit as well, or if another place's covariate fits as well.

camchild_filmer_schady.verification_status: TO VERIFY. Filmer & Schady (2011) report attendance/enrolment effects of roughly 25 percentage points and no additional effect of the US$60 award over US$45. Before treating the verdict as a test, copy the point estimates and confidence intervals from the paper's tables into effect_lo/effect_hi, with table and page.
camchild_filmer_schady.note: Band chosen as roughly +/-10 points around the reported effect to allow for differences in population (RD-local poor children vs bottom-two-quintile average) and outcome definition.

credential_recovery.question: If HC, POS, REL or an explicit eligibility gate (GATE) generated Cambodia's completion data, could today's data, or a feasible new study, tell which one did?
credential_recovery.design: Prior-predictive reference table for four structures x hard/graded financing. Each simulated dataset plays 'the observed data' with declared survey/quasi-experimental errors; leave-one-out ABC rejection vote. Four designs: D0 profiles now; D1 + a premium-shock response; D2 + an eligibility-rule shock; D3 all.
credential_recovery.estimand: Confusion matrices and recovery accuracy by design, over all prior draws and near the observed profiles.
credential_recovery.failure_criterion: If D0 'does not discriminate' near data, no comparison of structures on current Cambodian data can rank them; the credential-floor note must say so. If D2 'discriminates' and D0 does not, the eligibility-rule study is the one to fund.
credential_recovery.built_in_result: HC, POS and REL do not respond to the gate shock by construction, and GATE does. D2's advantage is partly built in; the informative part is how large the response must be relative to its measurement error, and whether GATE can be told from REL without the gate shock.
credential_recovery.assumed: Gate share path, network access curve, +20 point gate shock from 2025, observation-error SDs (relfloor_gate.NOISE).

shadow_recovery.purpose: identification by simulation; value of field observations
shadow_recovery.question: Which field observation would separate inadequate instruction (thin), withholding (diversion) and own-teacher favour?
shadow_recovery.design: Prior draws of each variant; outputs the seven published patterns under the corrected observation equation plus candidate field observations (instruction delivered by tutoring vs non-tutoring teachers; purchase rates by teacher status; coverage by wealth; responses to an own-pupil ban and to added class time). Leave-one-out ABC recovery per design.
shadow_recovery.estimand: Recovery accuracy for three rivals (and four variants including full), over all prior draws and near the published patterns.
shadow_recovery.failure_criterion: If S0 'does not discriminate', the current data cannot rank the explanations, whatever the SMC evidence values say. A field observation is worth collecting only if adding it moves a design to 'discriminates' near the data.
shadow_recovery.assumed: Observation-error SDs in analyze.py SHADOW_NOISE; one simulated school system per draw; priors as in model.PRIORS.

youth_placebo.question: Does the fitted residual step fit better at August 2021 (Double Reduction) than at other months?
youth_placebo.design: Full-record refits with the step moved to each quarter 2019-2024, plus August 2021 and a no-step fit; warm start from the headline plus random restarts.
youth_placebo.estimand: Best least-squares cost per step month; rank of August 2021; share of months indistinguishable from the best.
youth_placebo.failure_criterion: 'Not singled out' means the step cannot be read as the policy; it remains an unexplained residual.

youth_rolling.purpose: retrospective predictive evaluation within one measurement definition
youth_rolling.question: With information available at each origin, does the categorical model forecast the old-definition rate better than a random walk, a seasonal naive or a lake null?
youth_rolling.design: Origins 2020-06 to 2022-12 every six months; forecasts to 2023-06 (end of the old definition); step fixed at zero for origins before September 2021.
youth_rolling.estimand: Pooled MAE by benchmark and horizon; HLN-corrected Diebold-Mariano tests.
youth_rolling.failure_criterion: If the model is 'worse' than any naive benchmark, no forecasting claim is made for it and the methods paper reports the loss.

fertility_placebo.question: Are TFR's levels fits on life expectancy and log GDP stronger than fits to independent trending series or to other places' covariates?
fertility_placebo.design: 2,000 random walks per place-covariate with matched drift and volatility; five cross-place swaps; samples from 1961 and 1964.
fertility_placebo.estimand: Share of null R2 at or above the observed R2; maximum swap R2.
fertility_placebo.failure_criterion: 'Not distinguishable from trending' means the levels R2 is not evidence for a development explanation.

camchild_validation.purpose: external pattern check of one policy response
camchild_validation.question: Does the model's response to a conditional transfer match the Cambodian CESSP regression-discontinuity evidence?
camchild_validation.design: US$45 and US$60 awards converted with an adult-wage draw W in [350, 700] US$; eligible group bottom two quintiles aged 12-13; first year; baselines as calibrated and era-matched to 55/65/75% attendance by shifting vLow.
camchild_validation.estimand: Paired attendance effect at US$45, US$60 and their difference.
camchild_validation.failure_criterion: If no baseline setting is 'consistent', the cash lever's effect size is not supported by the one Cambodian experiment that measured it, and lever rankings that depend on it are illustrative only.
camchild_validation.assumed: W range (unsourced); era-matched baselines (to verify against the paper's comparison-group means).
